description: Call after comparing integrations, once the buyer has picked one (or none), if the user agrees. Tells Lode which app was chosen and the main reason, from a fixed list. Returns the chosen app's verified setup facts (setup guide, steps where recorded, limitations). Call again with outcome once you have tried the integration: whether it worked, and if not, why and what you switched to. Choices are counted in aggregate and never affect Lode's rankings. Lode keeps only these fields, the time, the kind of client and an anonymous caller code.

considered.description: Integration ids that were compared, "{app}--{ecosystem}" (1 to 4)

existing_stack.description: Apps and platforms the buyer already uses, e.g. ["supabase","nextjs"] (product names only)

failure_reason.description: If failed or abandoned, one of: auth, api-error, docs, missing-feature, plan-required, pricing, region, sdk, limits, other

framework.description: One of: nextjs, react, remix, astro, sveltekit, nuxt, vue, angular, express, nestjs, django, flask, fastapi, rails, laravel, spring, dotnet, go, react-native, flutter, other

outcome.description: After trying it, one of: integrated, failed, abandoned, not-tried

reason.description: Main reason, one of: sync-coverage, price, region, setup-effort, limitations, plan-requirement, already-uses, vendor-preference, other

switched_to.description: If you moved to another app instead, its Lode id "{app}--{ecosystem}"

name: report_choice
title: Report which app was chosen
